flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminprivateapi framework/workflows/datahiveuenfin/services/DataHiveUenFinService (createWorkItemForPRSC = placeholder), resources/sftp/sftp-common.properties (no State Courts folder), crud/ocmsizdb/OcmsOffenceNoticeDetail (batch_no commented out). ocmsadminapi crud/ocmsizdb/OcmsCourtCase + workflows/cas_integration (CAS payment only, not a court batch). ocmsadminui pages/Dashboard (empty), utils/data/LinkData (Work Items menu commented out), utils/models/Ibatchsummoncsmemo.d.ts (type only). ocmseserviceapi, ocmseserviceui, thirdpartyapi: no related code
note: Sheet status: Demo paid (50% of 75%); the demo remark mentions SFTP and a code split, but the repo has no code for this story. The story asks that once all notices in one court-application batch are fully processed by State Courts, OCMS creates a work item on the OIC dashboard. Not found: SFTP folder/job for State Courts, court batch tracking (batch_no in OcmsOffenceNoticeDetail and OffenceNoticeDto is commented out; only the TypeScript type Ibatchsummoncsmemo exists), work item creation (placeholder), and work item display on the dashboard (Dashboard.tsx empty, menu commented out). Searched with synonyms work item/workitem/dashboard, batch, court, mention, csd, ocms_work_item across the six repos (UI and API). SFTP config for prod/UAT/dev only has the CES, MHA, Toppan, LTA, REPCCS, ICMS and vHub servers. No relevant maintenance ticket. Singpass/SFTP partner: cannot verify from repo.
recommendation: Do not claim as done. There is no code to receive State Courts results, detect a completed batch, or create an OIC work item. Ask URA/the team whether the SFTP demo is built in another repo or not built.

steps.step: State Courts finish processing all court applications for the notices in one batch and return the result via SFTP
steps.detail: SFTP folder config only defines ces, mha, toppan, lta, repccs, icms, vhub; there is no State Courts folder or server. The prod sftp.upload.allowedSources lists only COMCRYPT_ENCRYPTED_LTA and COMCRYPT_ENCRYPTED_CES. There is no court download job under agencies (ces, lta, mha, repccs, toppan, vhub). The State Courts side: cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: OCMS knows that all notices in the court application batch are fully processed
steps.detail: The batch_no column in OcmsOffenceNoticeDetail and the batchNo field in OffenceNoticeDto are commented out. The Ibatchsummoncsmemo type (batch_no, summon_pdf, cs_pdf, memo_pdf) is only a TypeScript declaration with no entity or endpoint. The only court entity in the API is ocms_court_case (notice_no, court_payment_due_date, reason), filled by CAS, with no batch concept or 'fully processed' status.

steps.step: OCMS creates a work item on the OIC dashboard
steps.detail: Code creates no work item for the Court Processing Officer. The only work-item method, DataHiveUenFinService.createWorkItemForPRSC, just logs '[PLACEHOLDER] Work item creation skipped' and its comment says 'feature not ready'. There is no ocms_work_item entity/repository in ocmsadminapi or ocmsadminprivateapi.

steps.step: The work item appears on the OIC dashboard
steps.detail: The staff portal dashboard is empty: Dashboard.tsx renders one row div with no widget, and the 'Work Items' menu (LinkWorkItem) is commented out in LinkData.tsx under '//! UNCONFIRMED'. There is no work-item list page. The only UI creator of work items is the UPL Endorsement flow (useEndorsement.tsx:56,119 calls endpoint 'workitem' with work_ref 'UPL Endorsement'), not court; the 'workitem' endpoint itself does not exist in ocmsadminapi/ocmsadminprivateapi (cannot verify from repo whether another service has it).

steps.step: The OIC is alerted by that work item
steps.detail: There is no alert mechanism for the OIC: no work-item allocation (the comment at DataHiveUenFinService:2911 mentions ocms_work_item_allocation but no entity or code exists) and no notification to the OIC from a court process. A comment is not evidence; the method is a placeholder.
